title: FlagEval Findings Report: A Preliminary Evaluation of Large Reasoning Models on Automatically Verifiable Textual and Visual Questions
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating reasoning and safety in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) across various logic and visual tasks. While it includes a safety evaluation (StrongREJECT) focusing on harmful content and jailbreaking, it does not benchmark or analyze religion, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical philosophies.
